findings_fixed: [major] Linked node_modules emptied by npm ci: confirmed that the lane's node_modules was empty. Verifier worktrees must run `npm ci`, or `cp -cR` the install, or call `make -o node_modules/.kb-install-stamp`. They must not symlink node_modules and then run make plainly.

[major+minor, same bug] Crash with exit 2 on a tracked file deleted but not staged: scanSet now keeps only listed files that are on disk (statSync with throwIfNoEntry false, then isFile). New test 'leaves out a tracked file deleted but not yet staged' expects exit 0 and the file left out of the count. The real-tree test's recount checks existence too. The verifiers' ENOENT probes (docs/inbox.md, style-simple/SKILL.md) now pass.

[minor x2] Missed fences in blockquotes and list items, and raw HTML code: added unquote(), which strips blockquote markers up to the fence's depth, and fenceOpener(), which allows a list marker on the opening line. A fence now ends when its container ends, as CommonMark says: a line with fewer `>` markers, or a non-blank line indented less than the item's content column. `…` and a same-line `
…
` are removed together with their content, and a multi-line `
` block is skipped. Two new tests plant each case. The verifier's edge2 and html probes now give no findings.

[minor] Line opening on an inline triple-backtick span read as a fence: a backtick opener now needs a rest of line with no backtick. Also, an opener indented four or more spaces past its list item's content column is indented code, not a fence; openItems() tracks the open list items so this can be judged. Tests: 'reads a line that opens on an inline triple-backtick span as prose' and 'takes a fence indented four or more…'. The verifier's edge probe now reports lines 4 and 7.

[minor x2] Comment handling: an opener is now looked for only after code spans are removed and every closed comment is blanked, so a `<!--` inside a code span opens nothing. The line that closes a multi-line comment, or a `<pre>` block, is read from the closing tag on. New test 'opens no comment inside a code span, and reads what follows the line that closes one'. The verifier's probe now reports all three lines.
